scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n shared,backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run build -w shared && oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings && npm run lint:css -w frontend && prettier --check .
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w shared && npm run e2e -w e2e
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w shared && npm run migrate -w backend
scripts.migration:generate: npm run build -w shared && npm run migration:generate -w backend --
